items.title: Sanitation Officer flavor
items.text:
Processing and recycling the waste and trash of the havens
is vital for a closed ecosystem.

mechanics.effect: Flavor line for the new character. No home and no age are printed.

items.title: Sanitation Officer
items.text:
Sanitation Officer. As a free action, discard 2 Player
cards to take a City or Produce Supplies card from
the Player discard pile.

mechanics.effect: Discard 2 Player cards to take a City or Produce Supplies card from the Player discard pile.
restrictions: The card taken is a City card or a Produce Supplies card

items.title: Create a new character
items.text:
Immediately create a new character using this job.
Add that character to the pool of available characters.

mechanics.effect: Immediately create a new character with the Sanitation Officer job and add that character to the pool of available characters. There is no portrait.

summary: Create a new character with the Sanitation Officer job and add it to the available pool. No portrait, home, or age. Free action: discard 2 Player cards to take a City or Produce Supplies card from the Player discard pile. Corner badge on the flavor strip is 44.
